actual_scope: Exact #7630 word (our reroutes word on #7623, itself on #7621). Twenty-two swap-then-delete composites plus one joint hub re-settle: each composite is a SWAP-NULL relabel of two helpers h1,h2 (born at chart 3, ending at V) at a chart where both are present, followed by the deletion of the recombined stay of one of them at that chart. Every ADD/SCALE at the {0} chart and at V is then re-derived jointly and exactly so that all 1,569 final rows equal #7630's. Rows, end charts, the owned INIT/CLEAR/MOVE sequence (47 owned MOVEs, 180 lifetimes, peak 50, 68 labels) are #7630's; the CLEAR contents change with the hub content and each of the 180 carries an exact certificate under #7620's rule. Conditional on the same framework assumptions as #7630, #7623 and #7620.
scope_change_reason: Removes 22 paid stops from #7630's word: after a SWAP-NULL relabel of two helpers the recombined stay of one of them carries no content that the other does not already carry (empty-carrier mechanism, see README), so it is deleted and the hubs are re-settled exactly. Candidates were screened exactly over all interior stops and each stacked composite was re-checked jointly by exact replay.
bottleneck_link: Reduces the complete signed paid invoice per native call by {2:-18, 3:-6, 4:-20, 6:+20, 7:+2} (22 fewer MOVEs, some re-ranked), helper targets unchanged; over 17 calls paid positions 110,026 -> 109,652, rank-weighted S 1424 unchanged.
stop_rule: One literal word with exact arbitrary-input row equality, legality, the interior edit list, exact certificates for all 180 CLEARs, all affected-pair column tests (1,023 pairs), complete invoice and a certified crossing.
